title: Personal Blog
description: Multi-page static blog with content structure. PM defines requirements, UI designs visual style, Frontend implements and deploys.
userPrompt: 帮我做一个个人博客网站。React 静态站点，有一个首页展示文章列表，文章详情页，关于我页面。不需要后端，用 Markdown 文件做内容源。简洁的阅读风格，深色导航栏。
successCriteria: UI reads PRD and creates style guide
Frontend reads PRD and style guide
Blog has article list and detail pages
